description: This file defines a custom ViewGroup subclass called SecureViewOverlay used in an Android application to overlay and spoof layout of certain Views within a SecureView demonstration activity.

classes.name: SecureViewOverlay
classes.description: A custom ViewGroup that overlays and spoofs layout of specific views in a SecureView activity to obscure certain UI elements.

methods.name: SecureViewOverlay
methods.description: Constructor for SecureViewOverlay, initializing with context and attribute set.

methods.name: setActivityToSpoof
methods.description: Sets the SecureView activity reference for obtaining view positions to spoof.

methods.name: onMeasure
methods.description: Measures child views and sets the size of the ViewGroup.

methods.name: onLayout
methods.description: Positions overlay views to match original views from the SecureView activity.

methods.name: spoofLayout
methods.description: Aligns a spoof view with the position and size of an original view on screen.
